_note: Hand-reviewed prompt pack for the Chinese definition and expression prompts.
Every value was mined from the 2025 corpus (13,518 definition cells, 8,590
expression cells) and then human-reviewed. The measured basis for each field
is recorded in observations/v3-patch-crew-C.md (mining table) and in
specs/v3-prompt-comparison.md section 4.1.
A pack only ENRICHES the prompt. A language with no pack file still runs:
the builder degrades to the frozen V4 skeleton (patch plan D-10 / N-03).
COVERAGE METHOD for fixed_renderings_table: each percentage is the share of
definition cells whose DANISH definition contains the left-hand formula (for
the frame rows, the `der` form: `person der`, `noget der`) and whose target
gloss contains the right-hand rendering. Stated because a reviewer read the
`der/som` label as the denominator and could not land on the value: the
`der|som` denominator gives 60.0 / 36.5 / 58.9% for noget and 76.5 / 81.1 /
73.2% for person (EN/DE/ES), i.e. the whole table would shift, not one row.
Re-derived 2026-08-26: the `der`-form numbers reproduce exactly.
Danish text in the worked examples is HAND-AUTHORED in DDO's editorial
style. No DDO source text is stored in this file (v3_final_plan.md sec 2).
allowed_scripts / lemma_charset_rule / lemma_allowed_set / gloss_allowed_set
are read by BOTH the prompt builder and the G-SCRIPT gate: the prompt and
the gate must never be able to disagree about what a legal character is.
allowed_scripts: Han characters, Chinese full-width punctuation, and Arabic digits
orthography_rules: Use SIMPLIFIED Chinese only. Never emit Traditional forms (write 个 动 为 点 来 对 间 时 体 发, never 個 動 為 點 來 對 間 時 體 發). Never emit pinyin, tone marks, or any other phonetic transcription, in either field.
lemma_charset_rule: Han characters only. No Latin letters, no digits, no parentheses, no punctuation of any kind.
punctuation_rule: Full-width throughout the gloss: use ，and 。and 、and ；and （）, never their ASCII counterparts. Every gloss ends with a single 。
pos_vb: Give the bare verb. Chinese has no infinitive particle, so nothing is stripped; do not add 去 or 来 as a particle.
pos_sb: Give the bare noun with no measure word and no 的.
pos_function: Chinese has no single-word equivalent for most Danish function words. Open the gloss with 用于 or 表示 and describe the function (measured: 表示 22.7% and 用于 19.3% of function-word glosses; 用于 37.3% for interjections).

definitions.gloss: 指用力把某物朝自己的方向移动。
在房间内流动的冷空气，例如来自敞开的门。
指人或事物的显著特点，通常容易辨认。

fixed_renderings_table: især            -> 尤其是 / 特别是
evt.            -> 可能 (or 有时 when the sense is temporal)
om person       -> 指人 / 形容人
anti_patterns: bad lemma 拉 for sense 2 of træk -> the literal meaning of the Danish headword, which that definition does not carry -> good lemma 特征
bad lemma 名词后缀 -> a grammatical label instead of a concept (V4 lemma rule 2) -> good: name what the element means
bad lemma 究竟 (jiū jìng) -> pinyin in the lemma; 20 such cells shipped in the 2025 expression corpus -> good lemma 究竟
bad gloss 指用力把某物朝自己的方向移動。 -> Traditional 動 in a Simplified gloss; 325 definition cells shipped this way in 2025 -> good gloss 指用力把某物朝自己的方向移动。
bad gloss 指用力把某物朝自己的方向移动，这在物理学中称为拉力，常见于机械装置。 -> over-explaining past the Danish definition (V4 gloss rule 2) -> good gloss 指用力把某物朝自己的方向移动。
length_targets: lemma: 2 Han characters is the norm (56.3% of cells), 3 or 4 when the sense needs it (36.6%). 5 characters or more is 4.7% and needs a reason.
gloss: 18 characters is the median, 33 the 90th percentile; above 45 needs a reason. Exactly one sentence, ending in a single 。 (99.9% of cells).
gloss_allowed_set: Han characters, Chinese full-width punctuation, Arabic digits, the Danish letters æ ø å when a Danish word is named, and rarely a concise English word

fixed_expressions.gloss: 形容人意志坚强、敢于坚持自己的主张。
指变得极度兴奋或完全失去控制。
